name: Georgetown College
tuition_note: Private college, single tuition rate for all students. 2025-26 tuition & fees ($43,678) from georgetowncollege.edu/cost-attendance. Housing (room only) $5,410/yr from same official cost-of-attendance page (matches catalog basic-charges residence hall dual $2,705/semester x 2). Board/meal plan is separate ($6,274/yr) and not included in housing_cost.
